start_here: Say to your AI: "Give this buyer their friend discount at checkout." It runs tool:give-a-referred-buyer-their-checkout-discount, which reads the code they came with against your referral rows.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the referral_codes, referral_reward_rules and referral_code_target rows the pursuit database you name already holds.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the referral rows, such as example_for_who_runs_it; the computer opens it with the login its vault holds.
2. Give the code the buyer came with, their email when they are signed in, and the target row name.
3. Pass the answer's checkoutCode, adjustments and metadata to the checkout; an empty answer is a normal checkout.

worked_examples.title: A friend's discount
worked_examples.ask: Give this buyer their friend discount at checkout.
worked_examples.given: The database holds a member's code SITE-AB12CD and a friend discount rule (made-up values).
